meta.name: The Blame
meta.description: Detectives Tom Radley and Emma Crane fall in love while investigating the small-town murder of a figure skater, until one becomes a suspect.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: While investigating a murder, DI Emma Crane and DI Tom Radley uncover serious misconduct within Wakestead Police Station.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Emma's discovery of shocking video evidence leads to an unexpected breakthrough in the case, and she has no choice but to turn on one of her own.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With a key suspect exonerated, Emma is unable to shake her suspicion that a serial predator is operating within Wakestead Police Station.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Emma uncovers a potential lead to Sophie's killer as a link to another victim is discovered.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A suspect is brought in for questioning. Emma seeks help from an unlikely ally to bring her one step closer to Sophie's killer.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Things come to a head when the identity of the serial abuser is finally revealed, but Emma uncovers a further clue, forcing a devastating confrontation.
